BREAKING — Emmanuel Moreno was arrested Tuesday night, October 20, 2026, at 9:10 p.m., and booked into the Webb County Jail on three third-degree felony counts of smuggling of persons, according to Webb County booking records.

Moreno was booked on three identical counts of SMUGGLING OF PERSONS — each a third-degree felony under Texas law. Bond had not been set on any of the three counts as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956. The booking record lists his city as Laredo, Texas; the arresting agency was not listed in the record.

The smuggling-of-persons charge (Texas Penal Code, Section 20.05) relates to allegedly encouraging or inducing a person to enter or remain in this country illegally, concealing or harboring such a person, or assisting people in entering or remaining illegally.

A third-degree felony in Texas is punishable by 2 to 10 years in prison and a fine of up to $10,000. Webb Watch 956 will follow this case as it moves through the Webb County courts.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Emmanuel Moreno is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search (Oct. 20, 2026); Webb County public-access court records, Tyler Odyssey portal.

— Walter Webb & Willa Webb, News Anchors, Webb Watch 956
